newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian weekly forex demand jumps to $62.26 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian weekly forex demand jumps to $62.26 mln.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Thursday it sold $62.26 million at a rate of 85 naira to the dollar at its weekly auction this week.
Last week the bank sold $39.73 million at the same rate.

Dealers said it was the first jump in demand since the naira was devalued by 5.88 percent last month when the central bank also asked banks to provide details of forex end-users in order to stem capital flight and speculative buying.
